fastRedactBehaviour: With serialize: false, fast-redact exposes a redactor.restore method for caller-side reversal.
v4Behaviour: Deep Redact v4 redactors expose no restore, unredact, or reverse-operation method.
migrationAction: Do not migrate code that calls `restore` to an equivalent Deep Redact v4 API. Keep an unredacted source value separately if application logic still needs it.
reason: Deep Redact v4 is intentionally one-way.
